gaps.explanation: Schedule is 1,008 above the statement. The Road Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p9) prints Local 1,197 (TOTAL RECEIPTS 188,596), which counts the Road Fund sale of assets 1,008 as a receipt. The governmental funds statement (p4) prints Road Fund Local 189 (TOTAL RECEIPTS 187,588) and shows 'Sale of assets 1,008' under other financing sources. 1,197 - 189 = 1,008 = gap. Both printed totals stand (188,596 vs 187,588); no detail fix. (General Fund budget p8 total receipts 1,153,864 equal the combining statement p5 General Fund column.)
